result:
Iteration 6 is complete. `review_loop/verdict_06.json` is written and validates; `gold_standard_met` is false because this pass found real flaws.

**TLDR: the "matched trajectory budget" the whole design rests on was true at run time but false in the artifacts — the treatment arm didn't record its own unproductive draws while the control did, a pro-treatment bias confirmed on 5 of 10 real pilot instances. Fixed at the producer, tested, spec amended.**

The headline finding (T1/M1): `_collect_results` kept only completed trajectories with non-empty patches, and `run_branching` wrote prediction rows only for those — while the vanilla resample driver writes an empty-patch row for every resample, including failures. A treatment trajectory that failed or made no edits therefore vanished from the treatment's metric-time k. At the pilot's worst case (sympy-18189: 5 trajectories, 2 rows) the comparison becomes pass@2(2,1)=1.0 vs vanilla's pass@2(5,1)=0.4 — a +0.6 manufactured gain where the truth is a tie. Both confirmatory endpoints (H1 diversity, H2 coverage) inherited the bias, and iteration 5's productivity diagnostic was structurally inert on exactly the arm it was built to police. Three companion fixes: patches captured on `failed` trajectories were silently discarded (real data loss, in the anti-treatment direction); metric loaders kept stale orphan rows from superseded branching re-runs (now batch-aware like the eval driver); and the matched-k driver now warns loudly on old-driver/interrupted treatment metadata.

One new disclosed risk, deliberately *not* patched: in the pilot, every instance's proposals clustered all-singleton, so the entropy signal saturated at ln 5 and the τ gate degenerated to always-branch. RESULTS threat 11 now pre-commits the reading rule — if the real runs reproduce this, the gate is reported as uninformative at this substrate (a publishable negative finding), and retuning the entailment threshold post-hoc creates a new exploratory cell, never a quiet recalibration of the confirmatory one.

Verification: 82 tests pass (was 77, +5 new stage tests), py_compile clean, `compute_metrics.py` and `tau_sweep.py` re-run end-to-end on the real artifacts. The spec amendment (R7.2 predictions-record completeness) is recorded in `applied_06_predictions_record_completeness.md` with the tripwire check — nothing flips to pass, and the removed bias favored the treatment, so the evidence bar went up. Human actions queued in the verdict: ratify the amendment, run the pre-registered cell with the fixed drivers, and rebase the campaign worktree's `run_campaign.py` before launch.
